images.headline: Manufacturing & automotive
images.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium educational presentation slide, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Matched Data Science Masterminds Agentic Founder series. Premium Apple-inspired restraint, deep evergreen #142823 fading subtly to near-black green, ivory/white text, restrained amber #F4B544 and muted teal details. Space Grotesk-like headings, Inter-like body. Generous negative space, 6% safe margins, subtle studio lighting on polished friendly original 3D objects. No logos, robots, money piles, wealth promises or excessive glow. Large exact readable English text. Header upper left, one dominant illustration center-right, short readable text blocks left. Footer on single discreet baseline: left 'Data Science Masterminds', center 'Agentic Founder', right 'Kunaal Naik & Arpan Saxena'. No extra text. All text carefully spelled and unclipped.
INDEX LAYOUT instead of illustration: text-led chapter opener, very limited decorative imagery, airy five-row list with large type. Eyebrow 'CHAPTER 13'. Headline 'Manufacturing & automotive'. Supporting sentence 'Know shop-floor records? Turn that experience into a checked deliverable.'. Exact five entries:
AI-061  Factory SOP digitization
AI-062  RFQ intake structuring
AI-063  Quality report narratives
AI-064  Repair estimate explainer
AI-065  Supplier document index
Decision line: 'Choose one problem. Test one paid offer.' Exact footer as specified. No additional text.
